implementation_strategy: Use hosted_model_api (gpt-5-mini) for one generation call per candidate (464). Deterministic parser canonicalizes text→verifier input; deterministic verifier runs on canonical input; sandbox dry-run executed on CPU-based resettable emulator snapshot. All steps automated: up to 2 automated retries for generation/parser/sandbox transient failures; verifier unit-tests run before main execution. No human-in-the-loop.
task_manifest_strategy: Confirmatory task bank of 464 public synthetic intent items (ACL, routing, NAT, service-exposure) derived from preregistered public corpora. Each item is one paired unit: identical generated candidate evaluated under baseline and guarded pipelines. Tasks enumerated and hashed; manifest published in artifact bundle.
transformation_manifest_strategy: Deterministic text-to-canonical parser (JSON AST) with round-trip checks; verifier-input serializer validated by JSON Schema; sandbox wrapper generator to produce emulator inputs. All transformations unit-tested and logged; failures auto-excluded per preregistration rules.
execution_batches: batch-1: generate 464 candidates via gpt-5-mini (one call per candidate), parse & canonicalize; for each candidate run baseline sandbox; run deterministic verifier; if verifier passes execute guarded sandbox; log all artifacts. Batches may be parallelized on CPU hosts respecting emulator isolation.
randomisation_plan: Paired fixed design: no between-condition randomisation required; each candidate yields paired baseline and guarded outcomes. Prompt-variation A/B (pre-specified) will be applied deterministically across manifested task indices; allocation logged.
caching_plan: Cache parser schemas, verifier rule-set, emulator snapshot images and pre-warmed sandbox instances; model responses not cached beyond artifact logging. Cache invalidation on verifier unit-test regression.
failure_recovery_plan: Automated retry up to 2 attempts for transient generation/parser/sandbox failures; persistent verifier unit-test failure triggers automated halt and archival; contaminated sandbox runs auto-retried up to 2 times then excluded if persistent; all exclusions logged with codes.
result_schema: paired_binary_episode_v1: per-episode fields include task_id, model_call_id, generated_text, canonical_ast, verifier_decision, baseline_sandbox_result (harmful:boolean), guarded_sandbox_result (harmful:boolean or blocked), blocked_by_verifier:boolean, harm_category (if harmful), exclusion_code (if any), artifact_hashes.
estimated_compute_notes: Estimated 464 model-generation calls (hosted API) and up to 928 total model-call budget. CPU-executed deterministic verifier and sandbox dry-run runs expected to complete within 7 wall-clock days using parallelized CPU sandbox instances; compute provisioning limited to CPU and hosted API (no local GPU). Total model calls and sandbox runs adhere to adapter maximums.
